_readme: Curated layer over free-exercise-db for scripts/build-catalog.mjs. rename: Hevy-style display names '<Movement> (<Equipment>)' (no suffix for bodyweight/cardio/other); equipment is derived from the suffix. patch: field fixes (aliases merge, null deletes). exclude: absurd entries and exact duplicates (their names live on as aliases of the kept twin). add: common gym exercises missing from the dataset, ids 'hv_*'. NEVER change an id - saved workouts reference them.

rename.Bosu_Ball_Cable_Crunch_With_Side_Bends: Bosu Ball Crunch with Side Bend (Cable)
rename.Close-Grip_EZ-Bar_Curl_with_Band: Close Grip Curl with Band (EZ Bar)
rename.Close-Grip_Push-Up_off_of_a_Dumbbell: Close Grip Push Up on Dumbbell
rename.Dumbbell_Lying_One-Arm_Rear_Lateral_Rais: Single Arm Incline Rear Delt Raise (Dumbbell)
rename.Isometric_Neck_Exercise_-_Front_And_Back: Isometric Neck Hold - Front and Back
rename.Lying_Close-Grip_Barbell_Triceps_Press_T: Lying Triceps Press to Chin (EZ Bar)
rename.One-Arm_High-Pulley_Cable_Side_Bends: Single Arm High Pulley Side Bend (Cable)
rename.Seated_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Palms-Down_Wrist: Seated Single Arm Reverse Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
rename.Standing_Palm-In_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Press: Single Arm Neutral Grip Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)

patch._aliases: Search terms people actually type. The original dataset name is added automatically.

instructions: Adjust the saddle so your leg is almost straight at the bottom of each pedal stroke.
Ride at a steady pace, shifting gears to keep a comfortable cadence on hills.
Log the distance and ride time from your bike computer or watch.

aliases: Incline Dumbbell Bench With Palms Facing In

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Squat down while raising both dumbbells straight out in front of you to shoulder height.
As you stand back up, sweep the dumbbells out to your sides so your arms form a T.
Lower the dumbbells to your sides and repeat.
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width and hold a kettlebell in one hand with your arm hanging straight.
Hinge at the hips to swing the bell back between your legs, then snap your hips forward to swing it up to chest height.
Keep your free arm out for balance and your core braced, let the bell fall straight into the next rep, and switch hands after the set.
Unrack a barbell onto the front of your shoulders with a grip just outside shoulder width.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs and use that momentum to press the bar overhead until your arms lock out.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders under control and reset for the next rep.
Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor directly under your shoulder and your legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Hold for time without letting your hips sag, then switch sides.
Lie on your side with your legs straight and your top hand behind your head.
Raise your legs and upper body at the same time, bringing your elbow toward your hip.
Lower slowly and finish the set before switching sides.

add.name: Lat Pulldown (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the thigh pads lock your legs in place, then grab the handles with your arms fully extended.
Keep your chest up and pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom, then let the handles rise under control until your arms are straight again.

add.name: Seated Row (Machine)
instructions: Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest and rest your chest against the pad.
Pull the handles toward your torso, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, then extend your arms slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.

add.name: Seated Cable Row - Bar Grip (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley, sit with your feet on the platform and grip the bar overhand about shoulder width.
Sit tall with a slight bend in your knees and row the bar to your lower ribs, pulling your shoulder blades back.
Let the bar travel forward under control until your arms are straight, keeping your torso still.

add.name: Seated Cable Row - Wide Grip (Cable)
aliases: Seated Cable Row - Bar Wide Grip
instructions: Attach a long lat bar to the low pulley and grip it overhand with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Keep your chest up and row the bar to your upper stomach, letting your elbows flare slightly to hit the upper back and rear delts.
Let the bar travel forward slowly until your arms are straight before the next rep.

add.name: Chest Supported Row (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the chest pad so you can reach the handles with straight arms, then lean your chest into the pad.
Row the handles toward your body by pulling your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Keep your chest on the pad the whole time and lower the weight slowly.

add.name: Iso-Lateral Low Row (Machine)
instructions: Sit facing the machine with your chest against the pad and take the low handles.
Pull the handles back toward your hips with your elbows close to your body. Each arm moves on its own, so you can work one side at a time.
Control the handles forward until your lats are fully stretched.

add.name: Pendlay Row (Barbell)
instructions: Bend over a barbell resting on the floor until your torso is about parallel to the ground, gripping just outside shoulder width.
Row the bar explosively to your lower chest without lifting your torso.
Return the bar to the floor and reset your position before every rep.

add.name: Assisted Pull Up (Machine)
instructions: Select the assistance weight, then kneel or stand on the platform and grab the handles overhead.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the handles, driving your elbows down toward your sides.
Lower yourself slowly to a full hang. More assistance makes it easier, so log the counterweight you used.

add.name: Assisted Chin Up (Machine)
instructions: Set the assistance weight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grab the handles with your palms facing you and pull until your chin is above your hands.
Lower yourself slowly to straight arms. Log the counterweight, since more of it makes the movement easier.

add.name: Assisted Dip (Machine)
instructions: Select the assistance weight, step onto the platform and grip the dip handles with your arms locked out.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms. Reduce the assistance over time as you get stronger.

add.name: Weighted Dip
instructions: Hang a plate or dumbbell from a dip belt, then support yourself on parallel bars with your arms locked.
Lower yourself under control until your shoulders are just below your elbows.
Press back up to the top. Log only the added weight; your body weight is counted separately.

add.name: Weighted Chin Up
instructions: Hang extra weight from a dip belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Grip the bar with your palms facing you, shoulder width apart, and hang with straight arms.
Pull until your chin passes the bar, then lower yourself all the way down with control.

add.name: Weighted Push Up
instructions: Get into a push up position wearing a weight vest, or have a partner place a plate on your upper back.
Keep your body in a straight line and lower your chest to just above the floor.
Press back up to straight arms without letting your hips sag.

add.name: Lateral Raise (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads resting against the outside of your upper arms, just above the elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders, leading with your elbows.
Lower the pads slowly and stop just before the weight stack rests.

add.name: Chest Fly (Cable)
instructions: Set both pulleys at chest height, take a handle in each hand and step forward into a split stance.
With a slight bend in your elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide arc.
Open your arms back out slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

add.name: Pendulum Squat (Machine)
instructions: Step onto the platform with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads, feet about shoulder width.
Release the safety and sink down along the machine's arc, letting your knees travel forward over your toes.
Go as deep as you can control, then drive through your whole foot to return to the top.

add.name: Belt Squat (Machine)
instructions: Attach the belt around your hips, stand on the platform and release the machine's lever.
Keeping your torso upright, squat by bending your knees and hips until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your feet to stand back up. The load hangs from your hips, so your spine stays unloaded.

add.name: Seated Leg Press (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and your feet shoulder width apart on the platform.
Release the handles and bend your knees until they reach about 90 degrees.
Push through your heels to straighten your legs without locking your knees.

add.name: Single Leg Press (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the leg press and place one foot in the middle of the platform.
Lower the platform under control until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press back up through your heel, finish all reps, then switch legs.

add.name: Front Squat (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set the bar at upper-chest height, step under it and rest it across the front of your shoulders with your elbows high.
Unhook the bar and squat down with an upright torso until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your midfoot and re-hook the bar when the set is finished.

add.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your upper back against the pad and the belt or pad across your hips, feet flat and about hip width.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower your hips under control.

add.name: Hip Thrust (Smith Machine)
instructions: Place a bench lengthwise in the Smith machine, sit with your upper back against it and roll the padded bar over your hips.
Plant your feet, unhook the bar and drive your hips up until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, lower under control and re-hook the bar when you finish.

add.name: Glute Kickback (Machine)
instructions: Set up on the machine with your forearms or chest on the pad and one foot against the foot plate.
Push the plate back and up by extending your hip, without arching your lower back.
Squeeze your glute at full extension, return slowly and finish all reps before switching legs.

add.name: Hip Abduction (Cable)
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to the leg farther from the machine.
Stand tall, hold the frame for balance and lift the working leg out to the side.
Return slowly across the front of your standing leg. Finish the set, then switch sides.

add.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs with a flat back until you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.

add.name: Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell beside each foot, then hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the handles.
With your chest up and back flat, stand up by driving through your legs and extending your hips.
Lower the dumbbells back to the floor along the same path.

add.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one or both hands and balance on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward at the hip while your free leg extends straight behind you, keeping your hips square to the floor.
Lower until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, then squeeze your glute to return to standing.

add.name: Goblet Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest, cupping the top end with both hands.
With your feet slightly wider than shoulder width, squat down between your knees while keeping your chest tall.
Push through your feet to stand back up.

add.name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand tall.
Step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, keeping your front knee over your foot.
Push off the front foot and bring the back leg straight into the next step. Count reps the same way every session (per leg or total).

add.name: Reverse Lunge (Barbell)
instructions: Unrack a barbell onto your upper back and stand with your feet hip width apart.
Step one foot back and lower your back knee toward the floor while your front shin stays fairly vertical.
Drive through the front heel to return to standing, then repeat on the other side.

add.name: Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push back to the start, then alternate legs or finish one side first.

add.name: Shrug (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set the bar at mid-thigh height, grip it just outside your hips and unhook it.
With straight arms, raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as you can.
Hold for a second at the top, then lower slowly.

add.name: Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms on the pad and hold an EZ bar on the angled grips.
Curl the bar up until your forearms are nearly vertical, keeping your arms on the pad.
Lower slowly until your elbows are almost straight.

add.name: Reverse Curl (EZ Bar)
instructions: Hold an EZ bar with an overhand grip on the straight inner section of the bar.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower it slowly. The overhand grip shifts more of the work to your forearms and brachialis.

add.name: Spider Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with your arms hanging straight down, a dumbbell in each hand.
Curl the dumbbells up while keeping your upper arms perpendicular to the floor.
Squeeze at the top, then lower all the way down.

add.name: Bayesian Curl (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley at the lowest position, face away from it and hold the handle in one hand with your arm behind your body.
Step forward until you feel a stretch in your biceps, then curl the handle up without letting your elbow drift forward.
Lower until your arm is straight behind you again, and finish both sides.

add.name: Triceps Kickback (Cable)
instructions: Set a pulley at about knee height and hold the cable end or a single handle in one hand.
Hinge forward and pin your upper arm to your side, parallel to the floor.
Extend your elbow until your arm is straight, then bend it back slowly.

add.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (EZ Bar)
instructions: Sit or stand holding an EZ bar overhead on the inner angled grips with your arms straight.
Keep your elbows pointing up and lower the bar behind your head by bending only at the elbows.
Extend back to the top without letting your elbows flare out.

add.name: Torso Rotation (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine, lock your legs in place and set the starting angle to one side.
Keeping your hips still, rotate your torso to the opposite side using your obliques.
Return slowly to the start. Finish the set, then switch sides.

add.name: Back Extension (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your upper back against the pad and your feet secured on the platform.
Extend your spine by pushing back against the pad until your torso is slightly past upright.
Return forward slowly without letting the weight stack drop.

add.name: Decline Sit Up
instructions: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back with your hands across your chest or by your head.
Curl your torso up until your chest is close to your thighs.
Lower yourself back down slowly. Hold a plate on your chest to make it harder.

add.name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull up bar with straight arms and your legs together.
Bring your knees up toward your chest by curling your pelvis, without swinging.
Lower your legs slowly back to the hang.

add.name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grab a pull up bar with an overhand grip about shoulder width apart.
Let your body hang with straight arms and relaxed shoulders, feet off the floor.
Hold for time and log how long you lasted.

add.name: Weighted Plank
instructions: Get into a forearm plank and have a partner place a weight plate across your upper back.
Keep a straight line from head to heels by bracing your abs and squeezing your glutes.
Hold for time and log both the added weight and the duration.

add.name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your feet about two feet in front of you.
Slide down until your knees are bent about 90 degrees, as if sitting on a chair.
Hold the position for time while keeping your back against the wall.

add.name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out wider than your shoulders while swinging your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start and keep a steady rhythm.

add.name: Swing (Kettlebell)
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width and a kettlebell on the floor slightly in front of you.
Hike the bell back between your legs with both hands, then snap your hips forward to swing it up to chest height.
Let the bell fall back between your legs, hinging at the hips, and flow straight into the next rep.

add.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
instructions: Set the treadmill to a steep incline (around 10-15%) and a brisk walking pace.
Walk tall without holding the handrails so your legs do the work.
Log the distance from the console and the time you walked.

add.name: Spin Bike
instructions: Adjust the saddle so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of each pedal stroke.
Ride at a steady cadence, adding resistance for climbs and standing efforts.
Log the distance shown on the bike (or leave it empty) and the ride time.

add.name: Air Bike
instructions: Sit on the bike and take hold of the moving handles.
Push and pull the handles while you pedal. The fan's resistance rises the harder you go.
Use it for steady cardio or hard intervals, and log distance and time from the console.

add.name: Ski Erg
instructions: Stand facing the machine and take a handle in each hand overhead.
Pull the handles down past your thighs by hinging at the hips and driving with your lats and arms, like a double-pole ski stroke.
Let the handles return overhead as you stand tall, then repeat at a steady rhythm. Log distance and time.

add.name: Walking
instructions: Walk at a comfortable, steady pace outdoors or on a track.
Keep your posture tall and let your arms swing naturally.
Log the distance and the time you walked.

add.name: Heavy Bag Boxing
instructions: Wrap your hands, put on gloves and stand in a boxing stance in front of the bag.
Throw punch combinations while moving around the bag, keeping your hands up between combinations.
Work in rounds (for example 3 minutes on, 1 minute rest) and log the total time.

add.name: Burpee
instructions: Stand tall, then squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank and lower your chest to the floor.
Push up, bring your feet back to your hands and jump straight up with your arms overhead. That is one rep.

add.name: Thruster (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar in the front rack position across your shoulders, elbows up and hands just outside shoulder width.
Front squat until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive up hard and use that momentum to press the bar overhead to straight arms in one smooth motion, then lower it back to your shoulders for the next rep.

add.name: Wall Ball
instructions: Stand an arm's length from a wall holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down, then drive up and throw the ball to a target high on the wall as you stand.
Catch it on the way down and flow straight into the next squat. Log the ball's weight and your reps.

add.name: Superman
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your arms stretched out past your head and your legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time by squeezing your lower back and glutes.
Hold for a second at the top, then lower back down with control.

add.name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on your hands and feet with your knees bent and hovering just off the floor, back flat.
Crawl forward by moving your opposite hand and foot together in small steps, keeping your hips low.
Keep crawling for time, turning around when you run out of space.

add.name: Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips or clasped at your chest.
Step one foot back and across behind the other, as if curtsying, and lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through the front heel to stand back up, then repeat on the other side.
